meta.name: Surplus — Terrorised Into Being Consumers
meta.description: Featuring George Bush’s famous “go-shopping-speech”; Castro responding with hymns to the anti-consumerist, advertising-free island of Cuba; Bill Gates and Steve Ballmer preaching that the computer will give us peace on earth, and “bring people together rather than isolate them”, Adbuster Kalle Lasn warns that advertising pollutes us mentally, that over-consumption is unsustainable, that we are running out of oil and there is a coming global economic collapse.
